question: Should OpenClawKit retain or introduce explicit version-2 device-auth payload behavior and public full-reset helpers, or should this PR be limited to the WebSocket ping crash repair?
rationale: The authentication additions alter a compatibility-sensitive protocol and persisted credential surface that is independent of the reported continuation crash; repository policy requires an owner decision before adding parallel auth behavior.

options.title: Split to ping-only
options.body: Keep only the one-shot continuation repair and its focused regression coverage; propose device-auth compatibility separately with gateway evidence.

options.title: Sponsor the auth compatibility work
options.body: Retain the device-auth changes only after the auth owner confirms the version-2 contract, reset semantics, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Close the mixed branch
options.body: Ask for a fresh narrowly scoped crash-fix PR if neither auth direction is currently intended.

recommendation.title: Split to ping-only
recommendation.body: Keep only the one-shot continuation repair and its focused regression coverage; propose device-auth compatibility separately with gateway evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects steipete to the shared OpenClawKit identity/auth implementation.
